scraped.scraped_description: Coral improves community on your website through smart technology, effective design, and strategies that work.

name: Coral
tagline: A better commenting experience — open source tools for safer, more engaged online communities.
policy_outcomes: Adoption by major news organizations improving comment moderation practices
outcome_methodology: User adoption metrics and case studies from partner newsrooms
documented_limitations: AI moderation bias in non-English languages
Scalability challenges for very large comment volumes
Dependency on training data quality for moderation accuracy
curation_criteria: Open source contribution guidelines; community-driven feature requests via GitHub issues; moderation policy developed collaboratively with partner newsrooms
contributor_governance: Open source (Apache 2.0); external contributors accepted via GitHub
disparity_tracking: Tracks moderation outcomes by language and region; monitors AI bias in non-English comment moderation
community_ownership: Community-driven development through GitHub; partner newsrooms provide feedback on features and moderation policies
controversies: Concerns about AI moderation bias affecting non-English language communities
political_relevance_summary: Addresses threats to digital autonomy and privacy rights that affect civic participation and civil liberties.

movement_building_utility.notes: Technology platform serving civic technology needs.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication and adaptation. Already deployed across multiple jurisdictions (23 countries), demonstrating cross-context adaptability.
